response.sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), actor_shares AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS credit_share FROM actor_counts) SELECT actor_id, film_count, credit_share, credit_share - AVG(credit_share) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM actor_shares ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
